title: SynthLavaRNG
blurb: A Lavarand/LavaRnd-inspired, offline, visual-chaos entropy harvester with a SHA3-256 pool and HMAC-DRBG — optionally blended with Bitcoin-derived BitRNG entropy.
description: SynthLavaRNG is a digital reimagining of SGI’s Lavarand and LavaRnd. It renders animated, parameterized visual systems and ingests sampled frame state into a rolling SHA3-256 pool. The browser edition also mixes operating-system-backed randomness from crypto.getRandomValues() by default. An HMAC-DRBG construction using SHA3-256 is reseeded on demand and after pool updates. Optional public Bitcoin tip and mempool data can be mixed as additional input. Designed for local-first entropy research, cryptographic testing, and secure-seeding experiments.
author: [0xdeadbeef] of ZZX-Labs R&D
